```{r}
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE)) # Clear workspace
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
#install.packages("SCRT") 
library(SCRT) # SCRT package
library(data.table)

DataDir<-""
OutDir<-""

# Terugblik data (imputed version)
tb<-fread(
  paste0(DataDir,"2026-04-01_TerugblikIMP_export_260331.csv"),
  sep=";", 
  fill=TRUE)
tb<-as.data.frame(tb)
``` 

# cleaning data
```{r}
# make sure ordered in time
tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer) %>%
  summarise(is_sorted = all(diff(sent) >= 0))
tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer) %>%
  summarise(is_sorted = all(diff(time) >= 0))

#remove data after evaluatiegesprek
tb <- tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer) %>%
  filter(as.Date(sent) <= T3_Evaluatiegesprek_date) %>%
  ungroup()

# remove B17 (excluded from study)
tb<-tb[tb$Completed==1,]
tb<-tb[!tb$Studienummer %in% c("B21", "B23_original")]

tb$fse_imp<-round(tb$fse_imp,digits= 2)


```

# FSE: prepare df for test (df) ----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
test<-tb[tb$Studienummer=="B23", c("sent_date", "start_date", "active", "time", "phase_FSE", "phase_cis4_school")]


pad_to <- function(x, n) c(x, rep(NA, n - length(x)))
max_n <- max(table(tb$Studienummer))

# df with imputed FSE data
fse_imp <- do.call(cbind, lapply(split(tb, tb$Studienummer), function(d) {
  df <- data.frame(
    phase_FSE = pad_to(d$phase_FSE, max_n),
    fse_imp   = pad_to(d$fse_imp,   max_n)
  )
  names(df) <- c(paste0(d$Studienummer[1], "_phase_FSE"),
                 paste0(d$Studienummer[1], "_fse_imp"))
  df
}))

# save data
write.table(
  fse_imp,
  file      = paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_FSEimputed_20260331.txt"),
  sep       = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  eol       = "\n"
)

# df with missing FSE data
fse_mis <- do.call(cbind, lapply(split(tb, tb$Studienummer), function(d) {
  df <- data.frame(
    phase_FSE = pad_to(d$phase_FSE, max_n),
    fse_orig   = pad_to(d$fse,   max_n)
  )
  names(df) <- c(paste0(d$Studienummer[1], "_phase_FSE"),
                 paste0(d$Studienummer[1], "_fse_orig"))
  df
}))

# save data
write.table(
  fse_mis,
  file      = paste0(DataDir, "2026-04_01_FSEoriginal_20260331.txt"),
  sep       = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  eol       = "\n"
)



```

#  FSE: prepare df for test (randomisation)
the possible start points for each unit. 
```{r}
# load randomisation (possible starting points)
rd<-fread(
  paste0(DataDir,"2026-03-17_Randomisatie.csv"),
  sep=";", 
  fill=TRUE)
rd<-as.data.frame(rd)

# remove non participating participants
rd<-rd[rd$Studienummer %in% tb$Studienummer,]
```

# clean randomization matrix & value matrix
```{r}
rd_fse<-rd[,9:17]

write.table(
  rd_fse,
  file      = paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_RandomFSE.txt"),
  sep       = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  eol       = "\n"
)

```


# SCRT FSE (imp) 
graph(design=”MBD”)
quantity(design5”MBD”)    This returns the number of possible assignments, given the possible start points for each unit, as if there were no overlap, according to the formula of Koehler and Levin

pvalue.random()       in case of a high number of possible assignments better to use the "monte Carlo" version
pvalue.systematic()   no number, uses all

arguments   
data = read.table(file.choose(new = FALSE))

design = "MBD"  
statistic = “A-B”, “B-A”,or “|A-B|”.   
  would say: dependent on outcome.   
  increase is improvement: B-A  
  decrease is improvemnet: A-B  
    
save        indicate whether the randomization distribution should be saved into a file (save=”yes”).  
number    to specify the required number of randomizations
limit       minumum number of obs per 

starts        location of the file where the possible start points can be found.phase
starts = file.choose(new = FALSE)

package: "SCRT"
example:    pvalue.random(design=”MBD”,statistic=”B-A”,save=”yes”,number=1000)

# FSE -  SCRT
```{r}
# imputed data ------------
# difference between the means of phase means
obs_fse_imp<-observed(design="MBD",statistic="B-A", 
       data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_FSEimputed_20260331.txt"))
       )

# p value 
p_fse_imp<-pvalue.random(design="MBD",statistic="B-A",
              save="no",number=1000,
              data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_FSEimputed_20260331.txt")),
              starts = paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_RandomFSE.txt")
              )

# original data ------------------
obs_fse_orig<-observed(design="MBD",statistic="B-A", 
       data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04_01_FSEoriginal_20260331.txt"))
       )

# p value 
p_fse_orig<-pvalue.random(design="MBD",statistic="B-A",
              save="no",number=1000,
              data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04_01_FSEoriginal_20260331.txt")),
              starts = paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_RandomFSE.txt")
              )


fse_summary <- tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer, phase_FSE) %>%
  summarise(mean_fse = mean(fse, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = phase_FSE,
    values_from = mean_fse,
    names_prefix = "mean_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_B_A = mean_B - mean_A,
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

#fse_summary
fse_summary_imp <- tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer, phase_FSE) %>%
  summarise(mean_fse = mean(fse_imp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = phase_FSE,
    values_from = mean_fse,
    names_prefix = "mean_imp_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_imp_B_A = mean_imp_B - mean_imp_A,
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

#fse_summary_imp
fse_summary<-merge(fse_summary, fse_summary_imp, by="Studienummer")
fse_summary$delta_means_kalman<-fse_summary$diff_B_A - fse_summary$diff_imp_B_A

```


# Satisfaction - df -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

tb$satisfaction_imp<-round(tb$satisfaction_imp, 2)

  )
  names(df) <- c(paste0(d$Studienummer[1], "_phase_satisfaction"),

}))

# save data
write.table(
  satisfaction_imp,
  file      = paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_satisfaction-imputed_20260331.txt"),
  sep       = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  eol       = "\n"
)

# df with missing satisfaction data
satisfaction_mis <- do.call(cbind, lapply(split(tb, tb$Studienummer), function(d) {
  df <- data.frame(
    phase_satisfaction = pad_to(d$phase_satisf_health, max_n),
    satisfaction_orig   = pad_to(d$satisfaction,   max_n)
  )
  names(df) <- c(paste0(d$Studienummer[1], "_phase_satisfaction"),

  df
}))

# save data
write.table(
  satisfaction_mis,

)

# satisfaction - SCRT
A - B because lower satisfaction is less fatigue 
```{r}
# imputed data ------------
# difference between the means of phase means
obs_satisfaction_imp<-observed(design="MBD",statistic="B-A",
       data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_satisfaction-imputed_20260331.txt"))
       )

# p value 
p_satisfaction_imp<-pvalue.random(design="MBD",statistic="B-A",
              save="no",number=1000,
              data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_satisfaction-imputed_20260331.txt")),
              starts = paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_Random_Satisf_Health.txt")
              )

# original data ------------------
obs_satisfaction_orig<-observed(design="MBD",statistic="B-A", 
       data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_satisfaction-original_20260331.txt"))
       )

# p value 
p_satisfaction_orig<-pvalue.random(design="MBD",statistic="B-A",
              save="no",number=1000,
              data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_satisfaction-original_20260331.txt")),
              starts = paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_Random_Satisf_Health.txt")
              )

# background summary
satisfaction_summary <- tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer, phase_satisf_health) %>%
  summarise(mean_satisfaction = mean(satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = phase_satisf_health,
    values_from = mean_satisfaction,
    names_prefix = "mean_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_B_A = mean_B - mean_A,
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

satisfaction_summary_imp <- tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer, phase_satisf_health) %>%
  summarise(mean_satisfaction = mean(satisfaction_imp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = phase_satisf_health,
    values_from = mean_satisfaction,
    names_prefix = "mean_imp_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_imp_B_A = mean_imp_B - mean_imp_A,
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

satisfaction_summary<-merge(satisfaction_summary, satisfaction_summary_imp, by="Studienummer")
satisfaction_summary$delta_means_kalman<-satisfaction_summary$diff_B_A - satisfaction_summary$diff_imp_B_A

```

# health - SCRT
```{r}
# imputed data ------------
# difference between the means of phase means
obs_health_imp<-observed(design="MBD",statistic="B-A",
       data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_health-imputed_20260331.txt"))
       )

# p value 
p_health_imp<-pvalue.random(design="MBD",statistic="B-A",
              save="no",number=1000,
              data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_health-imputed_20260331.txt")),
              starts = paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_Random_Satisf_Health.txt")
              )

# original data ------------------
obs_health_orig<-observed(design="MBD",statistic="B-A", 
       data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_health-original_20260331.txt"))
       )

# p value 
p_health_orig<-pvalue.random(design="MBD",statistic="B-A",
              save="no",number=1000,
              data = read.table(paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_health-original_20260331.txt")),
              starts = paste0(DataDir, "2026-04-01_Random_Satisf_Health.txt")
              )

# background summary
health_summary <- tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer, phase_satisf_health) %>%
  summarise(mean_health = mean(health, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = phase_satisf_health,
    values_from = mean_health,
    names_prefix = "mean_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_B_A = mean_B - mean_A,
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

health_summary_imp <- tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer, phase_satisf_health) %>%
  summarise(mean_health = mean(health_imp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = phase_satisf_health,
    values_from = mean_health,
    names_prefix = "mean_imp_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_imp_B_A = mean_imp_B - mean_imp_A,
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

health_summary<-merge(health_summary, health_summary_imp, by="Studienummer")
health_summary$delta_means_kalman<-health_summary$diff_B_A - health_summary$diff_imp_B_A

```

# save SCRT output 
```{r}
library(openxlsx)

# Create output dataframe
output <- data.frame(
  Outcome = c("FSE", #"CIS4", 
              "Satisfaction", "health"),
  TS_imp  = c(obs_fse_imp,         # obs_cis_imp,          
              obs_satisfaction_imp,          obs_health_imp),
  p_imp   = c(p_fse_imp,           # p_cis_imp,            
              p_satisfaction_imp,            p_health_imp),
  TS_orig = c(obs_fse_orig,        # obs_cis_orig,         
              obs_satisfaction_orig,         obs_health_orig),
  p_orig  = c(p_fse_orig,         #  p_cis_orig,           
              p_satisfaction_orig,           p_health_orig)
)

# Create workbook and add sheets
wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "SCRT_test")
writeData(wb, "SCRT_test", output)

addWorksheet(wb, "fse_summary")
writeData(wb, "fse_summary", fse_summary)

#addWorksheet(wb, "cis_summary")
#writeData(wb, "cis_summary", cis_summary)

addWorksheet(wb, "satisfaction_summary")
writeData(wb, "satisfaction_summary", satisfaction_summary)

addWorksheet(wb, "health_summary")
writeData(wb, "health_summary", health_summary)

# Save
saveWorkbook(wb, file = paste0(OutDir, "2026-04-01_SCRT_results.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)

```
